name: Haha Ranman
source:
Wakura Mayuko, a newlywed, loses her husband to a ruthless killer and attempts suicide in her despair. Kaga Isamu, a young boy who also lost his parents to a murderer, saves her. Feeling a bond of shared sorrow, Mayuko adopts Isamu and begins a new life together.

A decade later, Isamu has grown into a young man. Mayuko, with the help of her psychiatrist brother-in-law Wakura Takafumi, slowly heals from her trauma. However, as she recovers, her memories of her late husband become increasingly distant.

One day, Isamu encounters a mysterious girl at a shrine who warns him that Mayuko will soon die a "psychological death" when her heart becomes void. The girl claims to have a solution to prevent this tragedy. However, it is as shocking as the prophecy itself: Isamu must undergo sexual lessons under her guidance to save Mayuko.

[Translated and edited from [url=http://www.alicesoft.com/haharanman/story/]Official Website[/url]]
translation:
新婚夫妇和仓真由子在残忍的杀手手中失去了丈夫，并在绝望中试图自杀。加贺勇是一个小男孩，他的父母也被凶手夺去了生命，他救了她。麻由子感受到了共同的悲伤，收养了勇并一起开始了新的生活。

十年后，勇已经成长为一个年轻人。真由子在她的精神科医生姐夫和仓孝文的帮助下，慢慢从创伤中痊愈。然而，随着她的康复，她对已故丈夫的记忆越来越遥远。

有一天，勇在神社遇到了一位神秘女孩，她警告他，当麻由子的内心变得空虚时，她很快就会死于“心理死亡”。女孩声称有办法避免悲剧发生。然而，这和预言本身一样令人震惊：勇必须在她的指导下接受性课程才能拯救真由子。

[翻译编辑自[url=http://www.alicesoft.com/haharanman/story/]官方网站[/url]]
